content.short: Common Ground leverages Web3 to build a platform for communities to work and collaborate.
content.description: Common Ground challenges traditional chat tools by offering a cleaner, more intuitive UX/UI, enhanced with native token gating for access control and proof of humanity to improve safety and user verification. It also embeds governance through Snapshot, enabling communities to participate in decisions within a verifiable, governance-minded social space. By combining these elements, Common Ground aims to provide a practical, community-driven alternative to mainstream messaging platforms that prioritizes usability, security, and transparent participation.
